Supreme's Week 11 release was a big one for the brand. Not only did Supreme drop a collaborative Air Max 96 and two pairs of socks with Nike, but the brand also opened a new physical store in Milan, Italy.

As is tradition, Supreme's Milan store opening was accompanied by a new Box Logo t-shirt, which was released in-store only on the day of its release. Supreme's Week 11 Nike collaboration may have taken a back seat to the store opening, but it was still a hit in its own right. The Supreme Nike release featured three colorways of an Air Max 96 and two colorways of a lightweight crew sock. This pair of Supreme x Nike Crew Socks features both brands' logos in maximal fashion.
